scope: Field-level authority for Fortnite lore entities and relations

principles.official_story_first: Fortnite News or another Epic/Fortnite page directly publishing the story fact is primary.
principles.field_authority: A source may confirm only the lore field it actually states; one official page does not authorize unrelated inference.
principles.cosmetic_not_canon: Cosmetic descriptions, shop availability and collaboration presence do not establish main-story canon unless the official story source explicitly does so.
principles.gameplay_not_lore: Gameplay mechanics, NPC spawn tables, boss gameplay and map presence do not by themselves establish faction membership or narrative causation.
principles.no_fan_wiki_as_fact: Community wikis, videos and social posts may help discovery but never become canonical evidence in this registry.

strong_relation_minimum: OFFICIAL_EXPLICIT or OFFICIAL_CROSS_REFERENCE for new materialized lore facts; seeded legacy canon may remain CURATED_LEGACY_OFFICIAL until URL enrichment.
